title: Tutorial child-screen teardown and counter state source break normal lesson flow
evidence: Actual client: demo running=false after openCounters; counter remains 0 in a separately preserved demo
required_fix: Preserve lesson across child screens and supply a demo-aware board/seat/action context

title: Stale Tidy preview moves a graveyard card back onto battlefield
evidence: Actual client handler probe: graveyard count 0 after apply; expected 1
required_fix: Invalidate/revalidate plans and protect against server-side stale position requests
acceptance: Intervening zone/attachment/controller/session changes cannot be overwritten by arrangement

title: Malformed edit discards last-good reward definition on reload
evidence: Added NeoForge GameTest: audit_existing present=false after corrupting its existing file
required_fix: Publish only a valid candidate snapshot; preserve previous snapshot with diagnostics on error
acceptance: Existing-file parse/validation failures and mixed reload preserve entire map; corrected reload and intentional deletion work

title: Independent text and control scales cause overlapping action-menu labels
evidence: Actual client screenshot at text 200% and controls 75%
required_fix: Use consistent text measurement/rendering and layout that accommodates font height and hit targets
acceptance: Readable menu and matching targets across supported scale combinations, window sizes and GUI scales
